notes.title: GIVEAWAY: Free skins!
notes.content:
💌 1. Invite your friend to play our game on iOS, Android or STEAM 
📺 2. Send a screenshot of him playing with or without you to us (via connect@bitten.by or in our discord https://discord.gg/rX4t4hpvuz)
🧟 3. Get any skin for FREE!
You can repeat it with up to 10 friends and claim 10 skins for FREE! The first one will be at your choice, then random.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40557673/b5596ad26582fea099efc62170bd37a5fe8ac653.png[/img]

notes.title: NEW UPDATE: Alpha Zombie is here!
notes.content:
Have you been groundlessly eliminated or betrayed by your mates?? Now you're able to recruit zombies nearby and coordinate efforts to attack players or ruin Shelter walls!
[img]https://bitten.by/static/media/alpha-zombie.536fa4c9.gif[/img]

In this update also we've added two additional languages:

[*] Spanish
[*] Turkish (thanks [url=https://www.twitch.tv/burakbek]Burak BEK[/url])!
[/list]
